title: Design Patterns
text: Create composite entities, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Number of input ports} sets the number of input ports, {Entity type name} sets the type name of the composite entity, {Bus object} sets the output and {Define input entity names} sets the names of the input entities used to generate the composite entity E1. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: port_1
ports.summary: Output composite entity scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Number of input ports
params.values: Specify the number of input ports 2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Entity type name
params.values: Specify the type name of the composite entity Combined (default) | character vector

params.name: Define input entity names
params.values: Specify the names of the input entities used to generate the composite entity {E1, E2} (default) | character vector
